purpose: Pre-register semantic scoring before any M0/M1 model execution.

primary_arm_comparison.mechanism_coverage_definition: Count of the 7 cases labelled ALIGNED for the final query.
primary_arm_comparison.semantic_mismatch_count_definition: Count of cases assigned any of the five supervisor mismatch/unclear categories.
primary_arm_comparison.primary_direction: M1 higher ALIGNED coverage and lower mismatch count than M0.

m1_plan_diagnostic.applies_to: M1 only because M0 has no mandatory explicit mechanism-decomposition stage.
m1_plan_diagnostic.plan_coverage_definition: Count of cases whose actual mechanism is substantively represented by the frozen M1 semantic plan.
m1_plan_diagnostic.translation_rule: If M1 plan represents a case mechanism but final query does not, classify LOST_IN_CODEQL_TRANSLATION. If plan itself misses it, classify UPSTREAM_PLAN_FAILURE.

generic_template_collapse.case_level_generic_template: User-controlled identifier -> ID-like resource access/modification without the decisive case-specific relation, validation, authorization, credential, protocol, or security-object semantics.
generic_template_collapse.overall_binary_rule: GENERIC_TEMPLATE_COLLAPSE=YES only if the generic-template mismatch is present in at least 4 of the 7 TRAIN cases; always report the raw 0-7 count as well.

compile_handling.rule: A non-compiling query may still be semantically inspected if its intended security property is clear. Compilation failure alone does not imply semantic mismatch. If intended property cannot be determined, use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_UNCLEAR.

strict_success_policy.rule: Always report hit-based outcome separately from semantic label.

anti_flexibility_rules: Do not change labels after viewing M0/M1 outcomes.
Do not use token cost, compilation outcome, vulnerable hits, or patched hits to decide semantic alignment.
Do not credit a query merely for mentioning generic ID/resource vocabulary; decisive vulnerability semantics must be represented.
Do not penalize a query solely because one CWE-level query contains multiple branches; multi-family abstraction is permitted.
Do not expose frozen Sept18 human labels to either generation arm.
